scope: U.S. passenger flights; Alaska, Hawaii and territories considered explicitly
research_method: Public provider pages, official documentation and published download links retrieved through web research.
verification_limit: Documentation checks do not establish that local downloads will succeed or that every raw source schema matches the importer.
live_validation: Not completed; no provider credentials used and no network block bypassed.
included_tests: Synthetic fixtures and mocked HTTP responses only; not real flights or real-time weather.
refresh_behavior: Dated jobs target identified releases. Rolling sources return data current when the user runs the collector.
